name: SHARE
aliases: Pose-free 3D Gaussian splatting via shape-ray estimation
definition: A pose-free framework for generalizable 3D Gaussian splatting that estimates camera poses via predicted rays and uses anchor-aligned coarse-to-fine geometry estimation to predict 3D Gaussian parameters without ground-truth poses.
summary: SHARE is a pose-free 3D Gaussian splatting framework that estimates camera poses via predicted rays and explicitly embeds pose awareness into multi-view cost volumes via Plücker rays for robustness to pose inaccuracies.
